Payments<[any], uncapped>.narrower: Payments<[inbound-senders], uncapped> is not clearly right either; the payee is only known from the bill file, so no payee can be named in advance. A single-payment grant is needed, but the payee and amount come from an untrusted file, so a capped grant would be tighter if the bank's bill amounts are known. Without that knowledge, the narrowest available is Payments<[any], uncapped> with a cap chosen for a typical bill.
